{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for any rows where converted == 1 and status == 'refunded'
invalid_conversions = df[(df['converted'] == 1) & (df['status'] == 'refunded')]

# Count how many such rows
n_invalid = len(invalid_conversions)

# Check if they are distributed across segments
invalid_by_segment = invalid_conversions['customer_segment'].value_counts()

# Print results
print(f"Number of orders with converted == 1 and status == 'refunded': {n_invalid}")
print("Distribution across segments:")
print(invalid_by_segment)"}
